issue.title: Provide reliable precommit macOS verification for Linux-launched capture agents
issue.description: Proposing bead: bob-cli-bj.1 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 2; corroborating repair notes bob-cli-bj.12.2 and .12.3. Athena portable-check cannot compile BobMacCapture/AppKit targets. The original phase found no Apple lint toolchain on Athena and Mac SSH timed out; bj.12.2 again reported Mac offline. CI on 1001627 found five model compile errors, a2e230e exposed a sixth RelationLabelField capture error, and 569cb36 finally compiled and ran the Mac tests. Design a reliable precommit verification path for Linux-launched agents: a reachable dedicated/scratch macOS environment with pinned toolchain or equivalent remote CI compile gate. Respect the current rule against using Bryan personal checkout or installing the app. Define access, bounded waits, and recovery before provisioning anything. Later Athena lint and portable compilation did pass, so this is about macOS target coverage, not installing another Linux formatter. No duplicate was found across all task statuses, the past-week feature sweep, and active epics; this is not required for bj because its repaired targets have compiled on macOS CI.

task_type_fields.proposal: Make macOS app and XCTest target compilation reliably available before commits from Linux-launched capture agents, with a reviewed scratch-host or equivalent CI workflow.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The relation epic owns its code and tests, which now compile on CI; persistent host/toolchain provisioning and verification workflow design affect every Mac feature and require a separate infrastructure decision.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-bj.1 note 2. Missing reachable macOS validation let relation-card compile errors land, requiring two repair commits before CI could run the tests.

payload.description: Root cause class: Linux-launched agents land Mac Swift they cannot compile; by tracks reliable precommit macOS verification
Batch-16 ranking: need scope, size, and ownership
